hero.description: Not probabilistic. Not a black box. Our hybrid approach combines agentic AI execution with deterministic decision-making, purpose-built for regulated industries.

problem.heading: The Limits of Probabilistic AI in Regulated Decisions
problem.description: Large language models are powerful, but they're probabilistic. Given the same input twice, they might produce different outputs. They can't explain their reasoning in terms regulators understand.
problem.emphasis: For claims decisions, this is unacceptable.

architecture.heading: Separation of Concerns
architecture.subtitle: Two layers, each optimised for what it does best

agentic.title: Agentic AI
agentic.subtitle: Flexible and adaptive
agentic.description: Uses machine learning to handle unstructured data, understand context and orchestrate complex workflows.

deterministic.title: Deterministic Decision Engine
deterministic.subtitle: Precise and auditable
deterministic.description: Applies encoded rules to produce consistent, explainable decisions every time.

auditTrail.title: Complete Audit Trail
auditTrail.description: Every field traces to source documents. Every decision traces to policy terms. Full transparency for regulators and auditors.

control.heading: The Control Layer
control.subtitle: Automation with oversight. Every feature designed to keep humans in control where it matters.

replayLogs.title: Replay Logs
replayLogs.description: Re-run any decision with the same inputs and get identical outputs. Every execution is deterministic and reproducible.

ruleTraceability.title: Rule Traceability
ruleTraceability.description: Every coverage decision is mapped to specific policy clause IDs. See exactly which rules fired and why.

approvalGates.title: Approval Gates
approvalGates.description: Configure thresholds for human review escalation. High-value or edge cases automatically route to experts.

exceptionRouting.title: Exception Routing
exceptionRouting.description: Automatic routing based on claim complexity score. Unusual patterns flagged for manual inspection.

confidenceScoring.title: Confidence Scoring
confidenceScoring.description: Field-level certainty indicators show where the system is confident and where human review adds value.

control.philosophy: AI should handle the heavy lifting, but humans must always be able to understand, verify and override. Every control exists because regulated industries demand it.

comparison.heading: Not Another Black Box
comparison.subtitle: See how True Aim compares to traditional AI approaches
